audience: agencies and consultancies that plan projects, track time and bill clients in Productive.io

useCases.title: Check projects and open tasks
useCases.text: List the projects of the organization and open one to read its details. List the tasks of a project, filtered by assignee.

useCases.title: Review logged time by person or project
useCases.text: List the time entries for a date range, a person or a project. List the people to find the id of a team member.

useCases.title: Log time for a working day
useCases.text: Log the minutes you worked for one day. The duration is in minutes, not a clock time. Your own person id is the default.

useCases.title: Create a task in a project
useCases.text: Read the task lists and workflow statuses. Create the task with its title, project, task list and status.

useCases.title: Update a task's status or assignee
useCases.text: Change the title, dates, status or assignee of one task. Only the fields you pass change.

useCases.title: Review client invoices
useCases.text: List the companies, then the invoices of one company, filtered by status or date. Open one invoice to read its totals.
